logical_health_metrics.label: Resource-control Request Wait — request P99 series

value_rules.canonical_numeric_storage: Store unscaled numeric values in internal evidence; formatting is presentation-only.
value_rules.percentile_priority: P99 is the primary analysis and display value for QPS, RU, request-duration and wait-time distributions. P50 and P95 are baseline context. P999 and Max are supplementary tail or peak signals. Time-window percentiles use the linear R-7 interpolation method.
value_rules.percentile_semantics: Always distinguish the percentile represented by each sample from the percentile across the inspection time window, for example: request-latency P99 series; 7-day time-window P99.
value_rules.counts: Display as integers with thousands separators; do not abbreviate.
value_rules.rates: Display two decimal places and an explicit per-second unit.
value_rules.percentages: Display at least two decimal places; retain additional precision when a small non-zero ratio would otherwise display as zero.
value_rules.durations: Display with two decimals using one unit chosen by magnitude. Preserve seconds in internal evidence.
value_rules.bytes: Display binary IEC units with two decimals. Preserve bytes in internal evidence.
value_rules.ru_rcu: RU consumption is a rate in RU/s and an exact counter increase for the window. RCU is configured capacity. Never label RU/s as RCU.
value_rules.time_window: Display start and end with explicit UTC offset. Preserve duration, query step and aggregation semantics in internal evidence.
value_rules.na: Use exactly N/A. Never render unavailable, prohibited, not applicable, permission denied, unverified capability or empty evidence as zero or Healthy. Preserve an N/A reason internally.
value_rules.identifiers: Render Cluster ID and full SQL digest as strings without truncation, scientific notation or numeric coercion.
value_rules.labels: Customer section titles, table headers, metric names, capitalization and ordering are immutable across outputs.

privacy_rules.customer_report: Must not contain checklist IDs, registry metadata, signatures, adapter state, applicability markers, implementation counters, raw PromQL, SQL text, digest lists, Top-N SQL or execution users in the default Health profile.
privacy_rules.logical_scope: Starter, Essential and Premium customer reports use tenant-scoped logical-cluster evidence only and must not attribute physical nodes, stores, regions, peers, disks, schedulers, Raft, compaction, topology or infrastructure logs to the cluster.
privacy_rules.internal_audit: Internal artifacts preserve registry selection, check IDs, raw queries, evidence, N/A reasons and deterministic gate state.

output_rules.markdown: The canonical customer report is Markdown generated from normalized evidence.
output_rules.feishu_wiki: Create from the canonical Markdown without adding internal audit fields.
output_rules.pdf: Render from the same canonical customer model; do not rasterize text tables.
output_rules.docx: Render from the same canonical customer model and preserve heading levels and identifiers as text.
output_rules.cross_format: All customer outputs for the same run must have identical customer-safe labels, values, units, statuses and N/A descriptions.
